A '''Dulok with [[Arrow/Legends|arrows]] painted on his belly''' was a member of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh's]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. He was a typical green-furred member of his species, although he had a pair of arrows painted on his belly.<ref name=":0">{{Ewoks|Asha (episode)}}</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic">The ''Ewoks'' series takes place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.</ref> Arrows accompanied King [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], [[Umwak]], [[Unidentified Dulok (X)|X]], and [[Unidentified Dulok (O)|O]], and [[Unidentified Dulok (diamond)|Diamond]] on a hunting expedition. They were defeated by [[Asha/Legends|Asha]] and several other [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name=":0" />
